name: KiriminAja
description:
Connect your KiriminAja account to your AI assistant and manage your shipment information through natural language.

The KiriminAja MCP Connector lets you access and analyze your shipping data directly from your AI workflow. Easily check shipment details, monitor delivery status, track packages, and retrieve relevant logistics information without switching between applications.

With KiriminAja, you can:

* Track shipments and check the latest delivery status
* Retrieve shipment and delivery details
* Analyze your shipping activity and logistics data
* Quickly look up shipment information using natural language
* Get actionable insights from your shipping data

Whether you're checking a single package or reviewing your overall shipping activity, the KiriminAja MCP Connector helps you stay informed and manage your logistics more efficiently—all from your AI assistant.

_published_faq.name: How do I add KiriminAja to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add KiriminAja to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.kiriminaja.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the KiriminAja MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: KiriminAja lists 15 MCP tools, including get_cities, get_couriers, get_districts, get_package_detail, get_packages, get_pricing, get_product_report, get_provinces, get_regions, get_shipment_report, get_sla_report, and get_subdistricts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to KiriminAja?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to KiriminAja in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
KiriminAja requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
KiriminAja is developed by KiriminAja. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
